script:
import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,subprocess,sys,time
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()))
from scripts.bench.cpu_lease import cpu_lease
from scripts.bench.sweep_freshness import fingerprint,index_listing
from scripts.bench.groebner_measure import FAMILY
listing=index_listing(FAMILY);fp=fingerprint(listing)
root=pathlib.Path('reports/bench-results')/f'hexgroebner-native-rows-{fp}'
if root.with_suffix('.measurement.json').exists():raise SystemExit('retain existing observation')
root.with_suffix('.manifest').write_text(listing)
binary=pathlib.Path('.lake/build/bin/hexgroebner_bench')
cpu,lease=cpu_lease();os.sched_setaffinity(0,{cpu})
metadata=dict(source_fingerprint=fp,binary_sha256=hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),cpu=cpu,affinity=sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0)),host=os.uname().nodename,load_start=os.getloadavg(),threads=1,toolchain=pathlib.Path('lean-toolchain').read_text().strip(),c_compiler=subprocess.check_output(['cc','--version'],text=True).splitlines()[0],schedule='2 blocks AB/BA; A scalar Lean row loops, B bounded native row updates; identical binary, fields, inputs and allowances; every completed sample retained',contract='matrix setup excluded; validation, allocation, elimination, output decoding and hashing included; F4 candidate only through interreduction, no certification',script=pathlib.Path(__file__).read_text(),commands=[])
start=time.monotonic()
try:
 for block,order in enumerate(['AB','BA']):
  for case in ['cauchy','sparse','cyclic6']:
   for arm in order:
    name=case+('Portable' if arm=='A' else '')
    base=pathlib.Path(str(root)+f'-b{block}-{case}-{arm}')
    command=[str(binary),'run','Hex.Groebner.Bench.'+name]
    if case=='cyclic6':command+=['--repeats','3','--min-total-seconds','0.5']
    else:command+=['--outer-trials','1','--target-inner-nanos','2000000000','--param-floor','64' if case=='cauchy' else '32','--param-ceiling','512' if case=='cauchy' else '256','--param-schedule','doubling']
    command+=['--export-file',str(base.with_suffix('.json'))]
    metadata['commands'].append(command)
    with base.with_suffix('.log').open('w') as output:result=subprocess.run(command,stdout=output,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    print(base,'exit',result.returncode,flush=True)
    if result.returncode:raise SystemExit('failed arm, retained logs and samples')
finally:
 metadata.update(load_end=os.getloadavg(),elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic()-start)
 root.with_suffix('.measurement.json').write_text(json.dumps(metadata,indent=2)+'\n');lease.close()
